name: imx646
description: Sony IMX646 (low-light variant of the same 1280x720, 4.86 um stacked event sensor). No low-light characterisation is published. Same package, array, supplies and interfaces as the IMX636 on the Sony flyers. Every pixel-response value below is a SURROGATE derived from the flyer ratios, not a measurement.

photoreceptor.tau_ref_s.uncertainty: factor 2-3; flyer latency 9 ms max at 0.3 lx vs IMX636 1 ms at 5 lx (1/I scaling of the IMX636 gives 16.7 ms at 0.3 lx, i.e. the IMX646 is ~0.54x)
photoreceptor.tau_ref_s.source: S16 surrogate (half the IMX636 tau_ref); Sony IMX646 flyer latency ratio

photoreceptor.tau_min_s.uncertainty: flyer: 800 us max latency at 1000 lx vs 100 us for the IMX636 (8x slower in bright light)
photoreceptor.tau_min_s.source: Sony IMX646 flyer latency ratio applied to the IMX636 assumption

ba.rate_hz.uncertainty: not published; flyer max background 5 Hz at 0.3 lx vs IMX636 10 Hz at 5 lx

hot.fraction.uncertainty: not published for the IMX646; 1e-5 to 2e-2 as for the IMX636
hot.fraction.source: IMX636 default-bias value (Hahmeyer 2025 (EventSat bachelor thesis, TUM)) used as surrogate
